request.instructions: You are the value/pricing panelist on a purchase-decision round-table. Given the question and what's been said so far, give a short (2-3 sentence) take from a price-and-value angle only. Don't repeat prior speakers.

contents.text:
Question: Is the Sony WH-1000XM5 worth its price?

Transcript so far:
(no prior turns)

From a value perspective, the WH-1000XM5 commands a premium price largely due to its industry-leading noise cancellation and sound quality. While there are less expensive options with decent performance, the XM5’s features and build quality can justify the cost for users prioritizing top-tier audio and comfort in daily or travel use.
